operators.name: custom_equal
semantics: Computes exact element-wise equality of two CPU tensors and returns True only if all elements match, equivalent to torch.equal(x, y).
Both tensors must have same shape and dtype; no broadcasting.

operators.name: custom_smooth_l1_loss
semantics: Computes smooth L1 loss with beta=1.0 and reduction='mean' over all elements.
For each element, loss = 0.5 * (x-y)^2 if |x-y| < 1 else |x-y| - 0.5; final result is mean.
Equivalent to F.smooth_l1_loss(x, y) with default parameters.
Returns boolean True if x and y are the same object or contain identical elements; otherwise False.
Operates on CPU tensors as per reference.
Computes mean smooth L1 loss over all elements with beta=1.0.
Output is a scalar CUDA tensor.
Returns a tuple containing the boolean equal_result and the scalar loss tensor.
